entities.summary: Wang Rong, courtesy name Junchong (濬冲), nickname A Rong (阿戎), posthumously known as Marquis Yuan of Anfeng (安豐元侯), was a Chinese military general, poet, and politician of the Western Jin dynasty. He was also one of the Seven Sages of the Bamboo Grove.
